findings.summary: A direct claim about what the reader feels was hedged into a possibility, and the request framing was dropped.

evidence.baseline: the request is to recognize that you are not as alone as the conditions make you feel
evidence.shipped: you may be less alone than the surrounding conditions suggest

findings.authorizedBy: Catalog 4.16, performed intimacy, and 4.14 applied in reverse by adding may.
findings.diagnosis: Two changes in one clause. The request is to recognize keeps all six addresses inside a single speech act, and its removal leaves this address as an observation rather than an ask. And the conditions make you feel is a claim about the reader's inner state that the corpus card forbids and CTD-0038 records as unresolved; the conditions suggest relocates the feeling to an inference the conditions support. The baseline is the more conscripting text and the shipped version is the more careful one, which is precisely why the choice belongs to the author rather than to a pass.

findings.summary: The four kinds of work the reader might be doing lost the whether that bound them as illustrations.

evidence.baseline: some version of what the book has been describing [mark] running a community, building infrastructure, doing the inner work, holding a piece of the larger inquiry the book has been pointing toward [mark] the request is to recognize
evidence.shipped: some version of what the book describes, running a community, building infrastructure, doing inner work, or holding a piece of the larger inquiry it points toward, you may be less alone

findings.authorizedBy: R-PUNCT-STRUCT, applied by deleting the marks without rebuilding.
findings.diagnosis: The paired marks enclosed a four-item appositive that carries its own commas. Deleting them and adding a closing or leaves the reader unable to tell where the list ends and the main clause resumes, which is a real reading failure rather than a stylistic one. The repair is whether, which bounds the enumeration and lets the enclosing commas read as apposition. The definite articles also matter: the inner work is the specific practice Chapter Twelve described, where inner work is a category.

findings.summary: Six precisions removed, including the two that make the isolation structural rather than personal.

evidence.baseline: it operates at the level of psychological experience as well as at the level of institutional architecture ... in conditions of structural isolation, with limited recognition, against headwinds that are often invisible ... What helps, when help is possible, is contact with others who recognize what you are doing for what it is ... finding them is itself part of the work ... people who do not yet know they are building it together ... is part of what makes the building possible
evidence.shipped: It operates in psychological experience as well as institutional architecture ... in structural isolation, with little recognition and against headwinds invisible ... When help is possible, contact with others who recognize your work for what it is helps ... finding them is part of the work ... people who do not know they are building it together ... helps make it possible

findings.diagnosis: At the level of, repeated, is the book's standing formula for a claim made at two scales at once, used in Chapters Two and Three the same way. Conditions of structural isolation names a situation people are placed in; structural isolation names a property they have. Often invisible bounds the claim where invisible universalizes it. And do not yet know carries the whole hope of the passage, since yet is what makes the not-knowing temporary.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the stored text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, the corpus voice card, the volume-02 voice card, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. The section pairs with the Final Note as the second half of the same unresolved question, and it shows the pass being consistent: both times it moved from asserting the reader's inner state to hedging it. That consistency is an argument that the pass held a view about reader consent. A view is a fine thing for an editor to hold and a bad thing to install without the author noticing, which is what CTD-0038 was opened to prevent.
